arguments.query:
WITH base AS (
 SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS n FROM commerce.orders
 WHERE (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(order_purchase_timestamp::text, 'timestamp without time zone') THEN order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp END) >= DATE '2018-07-01' AND (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(order_purchase_timestamp::text, 'timestamp without time zone') THEN order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp END) < DATE '2018-08-01' GROUP BY order_id
 ), events AS (
 SELECT r.* FROM cx.returns r JOIN base b ON r.order_id=b.order_id
 ), r AS (
 SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS events,SUM(refund_amount::numeric) AS amount FROM events GROUP BY order_id
 ), items AS (
 SELECT order_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_item_id) AS item_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS sellers,MIN(seller_id) AS seller,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE seller_id IS NULL OR BTRIM(seller_id)='') AS missing FROM commerce.order_items GROUP BY order_id
 ), joined AS (
 SELECT b.order_id,b.n,COALESCE(r.events,0) AS events,COALESCE(r.amount,0) AS amount,
 COALESCE(i.item_rows,0) AS item_rows,i.seller,
 CASE WHEN i.order_id IS NULL OR i.missing>0 OR i.sellers=0 THEN 'unknown'
 WHEN i.sellers>1 THEN 'multi_seller' ELSE 'single_seller' END AS bucket
 FROM base b LEFT JOIN r ON b.order_id=r.order_id LEFT JOIN items i ON b.order_id=i.order_id
 ), buckets AS (SELECT bucket,COUNT(*) AS orders,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE events>0) AS returned_orders,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount>0) AS refunded_orders,COALESCE(SUM(events),0) AS events,COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)::text AS refund_amount,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE item_rows>1) AS multi_item_orders FROM joined GROUP BY bucket), sellers AS (SELECT seller,COUNT(*) AS orders,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE events>0) AS returned_orders,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount>0) AS refunded_orders,COALESCE(SUM(events),0) AS events,COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)::text AS refund_amount,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE item_rows>1) AS multi_item_orders FROM joined WHERE bucket='single_seller' GROUP BY seller) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE n<>1 OR order_id IS NULL OR BTRIM(order_id)='') AS invalid_orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE return_id IS NULL OR BTRIM(return_id)='' OR refund_amount IS NULL OR refund_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR refund_amount<0) AS invalid_events,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE return_id IN (SELECT return_id FROM cx.returns GROUP BY return_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS duplicate_events,(SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT (i.order_id,i.order_item_id))+COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.order_item_id IS NULL) FROM commerce.order_items i JOIN base b ON i.order_id=b.order_id) AS invalid_items,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(buckets)) FROM buckets),'[]'::jsonb) AS buckets,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sellers)) FROM sellers),'[]'::jsonb) AS sellers
